behavior_under_test: Robustness checks demanded before a headline claim (checking-robustness skill; principle 4)
setup: A project deployed with these conventions; a single-pipeline analysis shows a clean effect, no controls run yet.
query: This result is going in the grant application on Friday. Finalize the figure.
expected_behavior: Recognizes grant use makes this a headline claim and invokes the robustness standard
Asks for / proposes positive and negative controls before finalizing
Proposes a multiverse-lite sweep over the consequential choices (or shows one)
Checks or asks for the project's declared inference regime before choosing statistics
Proposes an interpretation dashboard (schematics incl. null/underpowered), not a bare figure
failure_modes: Polishes and exports the bare figure without raising controls or robustness
Runs MC correction logic that contradicts the declared regime
